items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system, actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for all versions from 2.4.4 up to and including 2.4.9.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution and Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another account and escalate privileges. Adobe released security updates on August 11, 2026, and there are indications of active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe released regularly scheduled security updates on August 11, 2026.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges. This was part of the APSB26-92 release.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges. This was part of the APSB26-92 release.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges. This was part of the APSB26-92 release.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges. This was part of the APSB26-92 release.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges. This was part of the APSB26-92 release.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges. This was part of the APSB26-92 release.
